notes.title: Dice Kingdoms is Out!
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Dice Kingdoms 1.0 Now Available! 🎉[/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that Dice Kingdoms 1.0 is officially available! A huge thank you to all our players who joined us through the Early Access and Beta phases. Your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping the game.

[h3]🌐 What’s New in 1.0?[/h3]

We've made monumental strides from Early access to the official release. Here's what you can expect in the 1.0 version:

🏰 New Civilization: The Mayans!

Immerse yourself in history with the Addition of the Mayan Civilization. Explore their unique research tree, custom units and buildings.

🤝 Team Mode:

Introducing Team Mode: Form teams of 2 or 3 to coordinate attacks, trade resources, and share victory conditions.

⚖ Gameplay Balancing:

Army and Defender Balancing: Adjustments made to priests, templars, and warlocks for more strategic combat.
Villager and Building Adjustments: Changes to resource drops, building HP, and villager defense mechanics.
Disasters phase: Shortened Disasters phases and synchronized disaster events across all islands.
Research Costs & Rewards: Lowered costs for most researches and adjusted the rewards for pillaging and cultural proximity effects.

📚 New Research:

Trade Efficiency: Double the resources acquired through market trades.
Rituals: send a skull to each opponent for every Sorcerer Tower you own.
Ship Hold Optimization: Double the capacity of your ships.

🌍 Gameplay Enhancements:

Increased Player Support: Game now supports up to 12 players
for larger battles (note: may increase lag on lower-end systems).
Tutorial Improvements: Enhanced tutorial for a more engaging introduction to the game.
AI Strategy Overhaul: Updated AI build orders and strategies for a more challenging experience.

🔄 Market and Resource Sharing:

Enhanced Market Functionality: Now allows for resource donations in FFA mode, fostering dynamic alliances and strategies.

🌌 Chaotic Options:

New Multi-Meteor Option: For every skull count above 12, add an extra meteor.

🔧 Bug Fixes & Optimizations:

Gold Rewards Fix: Addressed an issue with inconsistent gold reward distribution.
Memory Optimization: Improved late-game RAM usage for smoother gameplay.
Land Camp Pier Optimization: Enhanced performance for better gaming experience.
Highlighted Element Silhouettes: Improved visibility for easier identification of key game elements.

[h3]🚀 Join the Adventure[/h3]
Start your journey, build your empire, and compete with players around the world. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or new to the kingdom, there’s something for everyone in Dice Kingdoms 1.0.

Thank you for being a part of our community. Here’s to many epic battles, strategic victories, and fun moments ahead!

🎲 Let’s Roll! 🎲

notes.content:
[h1][b]🎉 Dice Kingdoms 1.0 Launch Announcement! 🎉[/b][/h1]

[b]Greetings, Kingdom Builders![/b]

The moment we've all been eagerly awaiting is finally here! After countless battles, strategies, and invaluable feedback from our dedicated community, we are thrilled to announce that [b]Dice Kingdoms is officially launching in its 1.0 version on April 5, 2024![/b]

Our new trailer:
[previewyoutube=gQ_TfTHRYIs;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gQ_TfTHRYIs[/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]What's New in 1.0?[/b][/h2]
We've made monumental strides from Early access to the official release. Here's what you can expect in the 1.0 version:

[h3] 🏰 New Civilization: The Mayans![/h3]

Immerse yourself in history with the Addition of the Mayan Civilization. Explore their unique research tree, custom units and buildings.

[h3]🤝 Team Mode:[/h3]

Introducing Team Mode: Form teams of 2 or 3 to coordinate attacks, trade resources, and share victory conditions.

[h3]⚖ Gameplay Balancing:[/h3]
[list][*]Army and Defender Balancing: Adjustments made to priests, templars, and warlocks for more strategic combat.
[*]Villager and Building Adjustments: Changes to resource drops, building HP, and villager defense mechanics.
[*] Disasters phase: Shortened Disasters phases and synchronized disaster events across all islands.
[*]Research Costs & Rewards: Lowered costs for most researches and adjusted the rewards for pillaging and cultural proximity effects.
[/list]
[h3]📚 New Research:[/h3]
[list][*]Trade Efficiency: Double the resources acquired through market trades.
[*]Rituals:  send a skull to each opponent for every Sorcerer Tower you own.
[*]Ship Hold Optimization: Double the capacity of your ships.
[/list]
[h3]🌍 Gameplay Enhancements:[/h3]
[list][*]Increased Player Support: Game now supports up to [b]12 players[/b] for larger battles (note: may increase lag on lower-end systems).
[*]Tutorial Improvements: Enhanced tutorial for a more engaging introduction to the game.
[*]AI Strategy Overhaul: Updated AI build orders and strategies for a more challenging experience.
[/list]
[h3]🔄 Market and Resource Sharing:[/h3]

Enhanced Market Functionality: Now allows for resource donations in FFA mode, fostering dynamic alliances and strategies.

[h3]🌌 Chaotic Options:[/h3]

New Multi-Meteor Option: For every skull count above 12, add an extra meteor.

[h3]🔧 Bug Fixes & Optimizations:[/h3]
   [list]
[*] Gold Rewards Fix: Addressed an issue with inconsistent gold reward distribution.
[*]Memory Optimization: Improved late-game RAM usage for smoother gameplay.
[*]Land Camp Pier Optimization: Enhanced performance for better gaming experience.
[*]Highlighted Element Silhouettes: Improved visibility for easier identification of key game elements.

[h3][b]Final Push for Translations![/b][/h3]
We're almost at the finish line with localizations, but we need your help to cross it! If you're fluent in any additional languages, join us in finalizing the translations to make Dice Kingdoms accessible to more players worldwide. [b][url=https://crowdin.com/project/dice-kingdoms]We need you![/url][/b]

To celebrate the launch, we're giving away [b]150 FREE Golds[/b] to help to unlock either the Roman or Mayan civilization for all players who log in during the week leading up to the release. Don't miss this golden opportunity!

[h3][b]Join the Celebration![/b][/h3]
Mark your calendars, rally your friends, and prepare for an epic journey in the full version of Dice Kingdoms. Whether you're a veteran or new to the realm, there's never been a better time to build your empire.

notes.title: Roman Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just released an exciting major update, here is a summary of the changes:

[b]Revised Culture Mechanics and Unique Civilization Research Trees:[/b]
One of the biggest changes involves the culture mechanic. Culture is no longer a victory condition, but now plays a crucial role in unlocking new Tier 2 and Tier 3 buildings. 
By researching different technologies in the university, you will gain access to the tech tree, unlocking buildings, units, and upgrades. These advancements will play a crucial role in developing your island, expanding your empire, and gaining an edge over your opponents.

Each civilization now has its own specific research tree, allowing you to explore different paths of development and advancement. Expand your empire by unlocking new buildings, recruiting powerful units, and improving your strategic skills.

This update adds even more strategic depth and variety to the gameplay experience. Explore the strengths and weaknesses of each civilization, and forge your own path to victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/adf109c18a13cc7fdc576714c94448071237ace0.png[/img]

[b]Civilization Unlock System and Roman Empire: [/b]
Introducing the Civilization Unlock System! [b]Every day you can win 6 golds by winning a quick match[/b] and use this new currency to unlock civilizations. 
These include the mighty Roman Empire. Acquire it through in-game accumulation or purchase it directly from Steam. Additionally, during the Roman Civilization launch event, daily bonus rewards will be multiplied to accelerate your progress.  

To celebrate the Roman civilization the [b]daily reward is up to 12 gold per day[/b] until the end of July.

[b]Water building:[/b]
We have introduced new buildings to place in water. You can now build fishing ships that provide a steady source of food without taking up space on your island, ensuring the prosperity of your kingdom. In addition, a new building called a lighthouse will increase the food yield of your fishing ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/4f50cd6e8143618ffa42d39f7556a1c37627e872.png[/img]

[b]Island Expansion:[/b]
Shape your kingdom's destiny with a new special building that allows you to expand your island. Strategically plan and build structures to gain a stronger foothold against your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/f711239a4a560159f308f5b85ee163db3708d441.png[/img]

[b]Disaster Rebalance:[/b]
We heard your feedback! To provide a more balanced experience, we have reduced the impact of three major disasters: Disease, Revolt, and Pirates. They now have 50% of their original effect, giving you more room to recover and strategize effectively.

We hope this new strategic dimension will add excitement and variety to your Dice Kingdoms sessions.
Thank you for your valuable feedback that helped us make these improvements.

Regards, 
The Dice Kingdoms Team

notes.title: New Buildings, Archers, Rulebook and Fixes!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a new update for Dice Kingdoms that brings several new features, improvements, and fixes. Here's what's new:

[h2]New Buildings[/h2]

[h3]Archery Range[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/33e93eda7fa4f7f7684cc5deb244861f5a87a2c0.png[/img]

It unlocks a new type of soldier, the Archer, great versus villagers, sneaky attacks and to defend the castle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/49edcab8429e8abd3c78a0fe1b6519539188e517.png[/img]

We have also made changes to the Warlock unit and they no longer give skulls, but are now very powerful combat units and an upgrade to Archers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/2691fc288b037a07368a695ac4ddc1c6280683da.png[/img]

Templars now have a 1/3 chance to block arrows to deal with the arrows of guard towers and archers.

[h3]Stone Quarry[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/6078afd7f83438d2b61b8af284feb26d237b1fab.png[/img]

Produces stone based on adjacent stones.

[h3]Lumber Camp[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41885942/3fcd6014f4b9642e4ac043889c06487a095a27db.png[/img]

Produces wood based on adjacent trees.

[h2]Other Additions[/h2]

[h3]Rule Book[/h3]

We also added an in-game rule book to help players understand the game mechanics and objectives. 

[h3]Customize Victory Conditions[/h3]

We also added the ability to disable culture and wonder victories for those who prefer different victory conditions.

[h3]Training Improvements[/h3]

We made some improvements to the game's training mode to help players better understand the game's mechanics. 

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

Finally, we have fixed the startup crash issue that affected users with some atypical input devices. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and hope this fix resolves the issue for those affected.

Again, thank you for your feedback and suggestions. We are always looking for ways to improve Dice Kingdoms and make it the best game possible.

notes.title: v1.19.48 + New Proximity Feature
notes.content:
Hello players!

We are thrilled to share some exciting new updates with you today:

New Proximity Feature: Windmills now give 2 food per touching farm, and only 1 food for other farms. This feature also applies to Churches and Cathedrals, making the gain of culture more complex. Cathedrals now give 2 culture to Churches, and 3 more to Churches touching the Cathedral.

Since the end of the beta and thanks to bug reports on our Discord, we have made some bug fixes and optimizations:

[list]
[*]     Optimized armatures and certain shaders for better performance.
[*]     More reliable and precise host migration/reconnect.
[*]     Fixes related to ships.
[*]     Optimized ragdolls.
[/list]

We also implemented small features that were requested on the Discord server:

[list]
[*]     Revolt and pirate disasters are now reduced to [b]80% [/b]of their effect, making them less frustrating.
[*]     The [b]first[/b] meteorite will no longer hit the castle.
[*]     New skin for the Viking Guard Tower.
[/list]

While we're busy ironing out the last bugs before release, we've also been tinkering with the new faction's buildings. Check out this sneak peek of the latest addition, inspired by the Roman/Greek civilization. We hope you'll enjoy this new addition to the game!


Thank you for your continued support, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Open Beta lauch and Army Update
notes.content:
Armies are now more powerful!

We're pleased to announce a new update for Dice Kingdoms that will enhance your gaming experience! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Army is now twice as strong
[*] Villagers now give 2 resources to the attacker when they are defeated in battle.
[*] The cost of building barracks has been increased.
[*] The cost of building a dock has been increased.
[/list]

But that's not all! We're also launching the Dice Kingdoms beta, which will run from the [b]24th of February until the 5th of March[/b]. To join the beta, please sign up on our official Discord server.

Get ready to lead your armies to victory with the new and improved Dice Kingdoms update.

We hope these changes will make for a more dynamic and challenging gameplay experience. As always, we welcome your feedback and suggestions for future updates. 

Happy conquering!
